_comment: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/permissions (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/permissions). Every workflow and composite action of this repository already pins actions by full commit SHA (WorkflowContractTests, GovernanceWorkflowTests); sha_pinning_required makes GitHub refuse a run that does not.
allowed_actions stays 'all': the pins, Dependabot and the online zizmor audits (known-vulnerable-actions, impostor-commit) review each action instead of an allowlist.
